dedupe_keys.name: 衛星判釋全島崩塌地圖106年 landslides and debris flows series on taiwan government open data platform

description: 衛星判釋全島崩塌地圖106年 [landslides and debris flows] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 由林務局委託成功大學，以當年度1~7 月全島鑲嵌福衛二號衛星影像(93年度使用SPOT衛星影像)，建立自動判釋崩塌地作業標準，繪製崩塌地判釋最小面積為0. 1 公頃。 提供資料欄位包含：影像日期(Date)、橫座標(X)、縱座標(Y)、投影面積(m2)(Area)、坡面面積(m2)(SlopeArea)、平均坡度(deg)(Slope)... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal lists 15 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2026-06-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
